title: AI Governance InternationaL Evaluation Index (AGILE Index) 2024
base_benchmarks: UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology for AI Governance (RAM)
AI Vibrancy Toolkit (AIVT) from Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI)
Center for AI and Digital Policy Centre's AI and Democratic Values Index (CAIDP AIDVI)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as these topics were not part of its evaluation framework.
references: Gillespie, N., Lockey, S., Curtis, C., Pool, J., & Akbari, A. (2023). Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Global Study. The University of Queensland and KPMG Australia. doi:10.14264/00d3c94
UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on national-level AI governance, including development, infrastructure, industry, risk, readiness, legal instruments, and effectiveness.
